projects.name: gbx-net
projects.description: General purpose library for Gbx files - data from Nadeo games like Trackmania or Shootmania, written in C#/.NET. It supports high performance serialization and deserialization of 500+ Gbx classes.

release.notes:
- Added signature chunk at the end of written binary bodies
  - Added `GbxBody.Signature` and `Gbx.ValidateSignature(Async)` returning `GbxSignatureStatus`
- Implemented remaining MP4 and TM2020 `CPlugVehicleCarPhyTuning` chunks and discovered many of their member names
- `CPlugVehicleVisModelShared`: Discovered member names of materials, lights, particles, sounds, arms, and wheels
- `CPlugVehicleVisModelShared`: Fixed `0x01F` version 6 and `0x022` versions below 5
- Updated `CPlugMaterial`, `CPlugMaterialCustom`, `CPlugMaterialUserInst`, `CPlugMaterialColorTargetTable`, `CPlugLight`, `CPlugGameSkin`, `CPlugFxWindOnDecal`, and `CPlugTurretObjectParams`, `CGameItemModel`, `CFuncShaderLayerUV`, and `CFuncShaderTweakKeysTranss`
- Resolved few unknowns in `CGamePlayerProfileChunk_AccountSettings`
- `CGameCtnGhost`: Added TM2020 `TICK` chunk
- `GameVersion` now differentiates MP3 and TMT maps, and TMT and MP4 ghosts
- Fixed `GameVersion` in chunk versions and `IsGameVersion(GameVersion.Unspecified)`
- Added missing game version qualifiers to many chunks
- Increased default array, body, and skippable chunk size limits from 256 MB to 512 MB
- Added `MethodAttribute` to link properties to methods
- Removed forgotten `Experimental` attributes on `DeepClone`

### GBX.NET.Builders 2.5.1

*No release notes provided.*

### GBX.NET.Crypto 1.2.4

- Added `DecryptOnlinePassword`, `DecryptOnlineSupportKey`, `DecryptOnlineValidationCode`, and `DecryptKey` for `CGamePlayerProfileChunk_AccountSettings`
- Added `DecryptOnlineSupportKey` and `DecryptOnlineValidationKey` for `CGamePlayerProfile`
- Removed GBX.NET.Hashing dependency

Assets were automatically generated using the [publish workflow](<https://github.com/BigBang1112/gbx-net/actions/runs/42137736139>).

release.notes:
# AdminServ 4.0.0

AdminServ 4.0 is a modern, ground-up rewrite engineered for **Trackmania (TM2020)**, **ManiaPlanet**, and **TrackMania Forever (TMNF)** dedicated servers.

### Highlights
* **Universal Compatibility**: Full XML-RPC and map support for TM2020, ManiaPlanet, and TMNF.
* **Ultra-Fast Single-Page App**: Lightweight Preact + DaisyUI 5 interface (~20 KB JS) with instant Light / Dark mode.
* **Live Server Controls**: Real-time player counts, in-game chat with TM color styling, map rotation, and speed admin actions (Restart, Skip, Cancel Vote).
* **Map & MatchSettings Manager**: Drag-and-drop `.Map.Gbx` / `.Challenge.Gbx` uploader with author time and thumbnail extraction.
* **In-Browser Configuration**: Add, edit, and test dedicated server profiles directly in the web UI.
* **Docker Ready**: Deploy in seconds with `docker compose up -d` and automated `CONFIG_PASSWORD` provisioning.

release.name: ForeverTAS 0.2.7
release.notes:
# ForeverTAS 0.2.7

## Downloads

- **Linux:** [Download the AppImage](https://github.com/Skycrafter-dev/ForeverTAS/releases/download/v0.2.7/ForeverTAS-Linux.AppImage)
- **Windows:** [Download the installer](https://github.com/Skycrafter-dev/ForeverTAS/releases/download/v0.2.7/ForeverTAS-Windows-Setup.exe)

Once this release is published, existing installations can update from inside the app. New users can start with the download for their operating system, then let ForeverTAS recommend the matching GPU package.

## Fixed

- Session rows now show **Finish time** in seconds instead of nanoseconds. This also applies to previously saved sessions.
- Autorestart now starts another cycle even when no iteration meets the conditions. Stop and Abort still work, and cycles with no valid result do not save a fake winner.
- Fixed Tree search and Adaptive escalation on CUDA/HIP sometimes stopping with **"sandbox input timeline is invalid"** after finding a better result.
- The search could put reset inputs just after the simulation horizon in the wrong order when it used a previous winner as its new starting point. These inputs now stay in the correct order, including when they were already present in the original inputs.

Includes the full Linux and Windows package range: universal, NVIDIA, and AMD RX 7000/9000.

release.name: TM Vibrant Shaders 1.4.2
release.notes:
## TM Vibrant Shaders 1.4.2

For **TrackMania Nations & United Forever**: a new video export, resource packs on every map, a Horror look with car headlights, clear water and splashes, a fix for flickering overlapped blocks, photo mode in the MediaTracker, and a Misc page with split times (and a minimap in the replay editor and exported videos). **TrackMania 2** gets the Horror look with car headlights, clear water and splashes, car spray from the real tyres and menu pages in their own windows.

Tell me what breaks (with `Documents\TrackMania\TMVS\tmvs.log`, in TrackMania 2 `Documents\ManiaPlanet\TMVS\tmvs-mp.log`).

![TM Vibrant Shaders 1.4.2: Video export, detached windows for resource packs and misc settings, and minimap and split times on track](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cheatoskar/TM-Vibrant-Shaders/v1.4.2/docs/images/1.4.2-menu-misc.jpg)

---

### The video export

**The mod renders each frame itself.** With *Shoot video*'s *High quality* the game draws several samples and motion blur sub-frames per video frame. The mod now lights and sums all of them in float, then runs bloom, exposure and the colour grade once on the average. Bright lights streak like on a real camera instead of a grey smear, edges are clean, and the frame goes to the encoder in 10 bits or with a fine dither, so the sky has no bands.

**Better quality per megabyte.** One slider (*Video quality*, 80) that I calibrated with VMAF on a grainy 1440p60 replay: 80 is hard to tell from the source, 92 is for editing. On NVIDIA cards (driver R570 or newer) the mod drives NVENC directly instead of going through Windows. At the same 75 Mbit/s it scored 98.0 where x264 medium scored 97.1, Windows' NVENC path needed 82 Mbit/s for that, and it encodes faster than the export renders. AMD and Intel cards still use Windows' encoders, now at a higher bitrate (I could not measure them).

**HDR10.** With HEVC in 10 bits and the *HDR10* preset, lamps, the sun and glows stay brighter than white on an HDR screen (up to 1000 nits, white at 203). Up to white it is the same picture as the SDR video.

**The game's own sound.** The export's sound pass used to record Windows' default recording device: a microphone gave the room, no recording device gave silence. The mod now hands the game its own output (Windows 10 2004 or newer). Rain is in it also with the game in the background, thunder comes after the flashes you see in the video, and a clip that doesn't start at 0 gets the right sound. The sound pass still needs the sound button in the *Shoot video* dialog.

**A Video page in the `F8` menu** with presets for what the file is for (*YouTube*, *Best*, *Editing*, *Small*, *Discord*, *HDR10*) and its look (*Replay*, or *Cinema* with a film shutter, lens depth of field and 2.39:1). Also new: 10-bit HEVC and AV1, ffmpeg as encoder (x264, x265, SVT-AV1 through your own `ffmpeg.exe`, the better choice with AMD or Intel), film grain and a crop for the video.

**Faster.** The encoder runs on its own thread and the colour conversion on the graphics card, and with the mod's frames the game no longer reads each frame back to the CPU.

---

### Overlapping blocks no longer flicker

On TMUnlimiter maps two blocks placed into each other used to flicker in stripes. Now the block placed last is shown (*Overlapping blocks: last placed on top*, on). Action blocks win over plain ones in this order: engine off, boosters, start/finish/checkpoint, everything else, so a booster inside a start block stays visible. It also works with the effects off.

### Resource packs on every map

A new **Resource packs** page: your environment mods from `Skins\<Environment>\Mod` (DarkBlue, NEONglowSTICKS, ...) on every map you load, with a card and picture per pack. *Map's own*, *None* or a pack, optionally one per map mood (day, sunset, night). *Apply* switches the loaded map at once, without reloading. release.name: eswc-autosave 1.0.1
release.notes:
Replay autosave and online login fix for TrackMania Nations ESWC (unofficial 1.80 patch, exe 0.1.7.9).

**What's new**
- `dinput8.dll` is now a 4 KB loader only: it passes every DirectInput call unchanged to the system's `dinput8.dll` and loads `eswc_autosave.dll` from the same folder. All the mod's logic is in `eswc_autosave.dll`. Behaviour is the same as 1.0.0.

**Install / update**
Close the game and copy `dinput8.dll`, `eswc_autosave.dll` and `eswc_autosave.ini` next to `TmNationsESWC.exe` (when updating from 1.0.0: replace `dinput8.dll`, add `eswc_autosave.dll`; keep your ini). `eswc_autosave.log` should show `eswc_autosave 1.0.1 start` and `ready: ...`.

**Not included:** the TMX copy (single-ghost copy of online replays) is in the source but not in this release, until the TM-Exchange moderators have said whether such copies are allowed.

SHA-256
- `dinput8.dll` ac9a449ab090ee44cc01e0dbece7c4d13b7e25502d819ee02e66e470e1bc7de0
- `eswc_autosave.dll` c948452005604f22ae19dea0d1f0fef0e341c64d919630d1fe93fc5e4325b4c9
